sections.heading: C2 — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A04
Obtaining liability insurance from an insurer licensed to operate in Delaware establishes the owner’s financial responsibility for titling and registration. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A04
Minimum personal-injury protection is $15,000 for one person injured in a crash. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A04
Minimum personal-injury protection is $30,000 for all people injured in one crash. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A04
Minimum liability coverage for one person’s bodily injury or death in a crash is $25,000. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A04
Minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of at least two people in a crash is $50,000. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A04
Minimum coverage for damage to other people’s property in a crash is $10,000. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A04
An original Delaware insurance identification card is an acceptable insurance document and may be electronic or paper. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A04
The insurance card must stay in the vehicle and show coverage dates, a valid expiration and the insurer’s NAIC code. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A04
Insurance identification cards are issued again every six months. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A04
A valid insurance policy is accepted as proof of coverage. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A04
A written binder is acceptable within 30 days after issue when supplied by an insurer or agent on the insurer’s letterhead. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A04
Faxed insurance proof is accepted only when the insurer sends it directly to the DMV; a third-party fax is rejected. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A04
Electronic insurance proof is subject to verification. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A04
Driving an uninsured vehicle carries a fine from $1,500 to $2,000. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A04
A later uninsured-driving offense within three years of an earlier offense carries a $3,000 to $4,000 fine. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A04
False insurance proof brings an additional $500 fine, 30 days in jail, or both. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A05
After proper notice to the owner, authorized insurance personnel or law-enforcement officials may take the plate when affirmative insurance proof is absent. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A05
Before canceling insurance, the owner must surrender a valid plate to the DMV or face fines. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A05
The DMV conducts random insurance-proof audits of active registrations. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A05
The insurance-audit penalty is $100 for the first 1 to 30 uninsured days, then $5 daily until insurance, tag surrender or registration expiration. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A05
An owner’s failure to answer an insurance-audit request results in registration suspension. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A05
Reinstating a suspended registration after the insurance-audit process costs $50 per registration. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A05
Vehicle inspection is the second step in the Delaware title and registration process. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A05
A title certificate or registration card must be presented for inspection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R25 | anchor: A05
Delaware residents are not charged for vehicle inspection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R26 | anchor: A05
Inspection requires lamps to work, be clean and have correct aim. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R27 | anchor: A05
Every vehicle brought for inspection receives a brake-performance test. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R28 | anchor: A05
Inspection mirrors must be intact and clean. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R29 | anchor: A05
Inspection wipers must work fully and have sound rubber blades. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R30 | anchor: A05
Hood and trunk latches must keep their panels completely closed. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R31 | anchor: A05
Inspection tires may not have cuts, bulges, bald patches or exposed fabric. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R32 | anchor: A05
Inspection tread depth must reach at least 2/32 inch in two neighboring treads. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R33 | anchor: A05
Working door handles or an equivalent mechanism must be present. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R34 | anchor: A05
Damaged or displaced protruding parts that create a safety hazard are unacceptable. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R35 | anchor: A05
The horn must function for inspection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R36 | anchor: A05
The inspection requires a noise-reducing muffler and an exhaust system without leaks. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R37 | anchor: A05
A catalytic converter is required when the manufacturer originally fitted one. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R38 | anchor: A05
No visible fuel, oil or coolant leakage is allowed for inspection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec07-R39 | anchor: A06
Seat belts must be worn at inspection. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R40 | anchor: A06
A passenger-car bumper’s bottom may be no higher than 22 inches above ground. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R41 | anchor: A06
The gap between the body and frame rail may not exceed three inches. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R42 | anchor: A06
A hood-mounted air scoop may not exceed three inches. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R43 | anchor: A06
Vehicles from model years 1968 through 1995 are tested for exhaust emissions. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R44 | anchor: A06
Gas-powered vehicles from 1996 onward weighing under 8,000 pounds receive an OBD-II test. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R45 | anchor: A06
Gas or diesel vehicles from 2008 onward with GVWR from 8,501 to 14,000 receive OBD-II testing. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R46 | anchor: A06
A windshield crack longer than five inches is a mandatory inspection failure. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R47 | anchor: A06
A star chip larger than one inch is a mandatory windshield inspection failure. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R48 | anchor: A06
Windshield visibility height must be at least 10 inches. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R49 | anchor: A06
Vehicles seven model years old or newer avoid inspection except a VIN inspection if never titled in Delaware. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R50 | anchor: A06
Vehicles seven years old receive a one-year renewal without inspection. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R51 | anchor: A06
Renewing after registration expiration incurs a $20 late fee. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

sections.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration
sections.heading: C2 — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration — continuation

FACT_ID: sec07-R52 | anchor: A06
An unsafe, improperly equipped or improperly repaired vehicle is rejected and must be corrected, reinspected and passed before title, registration and plate issuance. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R53 | anchor: A06
An owner nearing registration expiration may qualify for a $20 temporary tag when the inspection failure is unrelated to safety. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R54 | anchor: A06
The third registration step is applying for a Delaware title and registration. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R55 | anchor: A06
A title certificate from a title-issuing state must be surrendered to the DMV when applying. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R56 | anchor: A06
When a lien prevents obtaining the title, the DMV provides form MV-35 for requesting it from the lienholder. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R57 | anchor: A06
After emissions and safety inspections are passed, the technician supplies the MV-212 title application and inspection report. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R58 | anchor: A06
The application requires all owners’ signatures, an authorized person with original power of attorney, or a company officer’s signature. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec07-R59 | anchor: A07
An out-of-state vehicle brought for Delaware titling or registration normally has a document fee of 5.25 percent of its current NADA average trade-in value, with an $8 minimum. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R60 | anchor: A07
The document-fee exception requires proof of a sales, transfer or similar vehicle-purchase levy paid to another state within the preceding 90 days. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R61 | anchor: A07
The handbook gives a 3.75 percent document fee for mobile homes. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R62 | anchor: A07
Liability-insurance proof must be provided when a vehicle is titled or registered. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R63 | anchor: A07
The title fee without a lien is $35. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R64 | anchor: A07
The title fee with a lien is $55. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R65 | anchor: A07
When a lien exists, the title goes to the lienholder and the customer must supply the correct address. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R66 | anchor: A07
Passenger-vehicle registration costs $40 for one year. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R67 | anchor: A07
Passenger-vehicle registration costs $80 for two years. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R68 | anchor: A07
During a vehicle’s first seven model years, its model year determines eligibility for registration lasting one to seven years. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R69 | anchor: A07
Six-month registration costs $21. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R70 | anchor: A07
Additional registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles start October 1, 2025 in the handbook. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R71 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR 6,000 pounds or less is $110. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R72 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above 6,000 through 10,000 pounds is $150. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R73 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above 10,000 through 26,000 pounds is $260. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R74 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above 26,000 pounds is $900. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R75 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR 6,000 pounds or less is $85. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R76 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above 6,000 through 10,000 pounds is $115. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R77 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above 10,000 through 26,000 pounds is $200. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R78 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above 26,000 pounds is $600. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R79 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR 6,000 pounds or less is $60. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R80 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above 6,000 through 10,000 pounds is $80. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R81 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above 10,000 through 26,000 pounds is $140. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R82 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above 26,000 pounds is $480. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R83 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR 6,000 pounds or less is $110. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R84 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above 6,000 through 10,000 pounds is $150. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R85 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above 10,000 through 26,000 pounds is $260. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R86 | anchor: A07
The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above 26,000 pounds is $900. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec07-R87 | anchor: A08
Once required documents are accepted and document, title and registration fees are paid, the DMV issues the title, registration card and plate; a lienholder receives the title when applicable. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R88 | anchor: A08
An applicant younger than 18 needs a parent, guardian or documented court-appointed custodian to sign consent for a title application. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R89 | anchor: A08
Before registration renewal, proof of adequate liability insurance and the required safety and emissions inspections must be presented. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R90 | anchor: A08
A vehicle may be inspected during the 90 days before registration expiration, and early renewal does not reduce the registration term. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R91 | anchor: A08
Active-duty military personnel are excepted from the late-renewal fee as described in the handbook’s fee chart. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R92 | anchor: A08
Trailers of 4,000 pounds or less do not need a new inspection before registration renewal. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R93 | anchor: A08
Owners eligible for mail renewal are notified by mail, email or telephone 90 days before registration expiration. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R94 | anchor: A08
A Delaware address change must be reported within 30 days to both the DMV’s vehicle and driver-license sections. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R95 | anchor: A08
A registration address can be changed online or by writing to Vehicle Services; the DMV sends a replacement registration card without a fee for the written process. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R96 | anchor: A08
After changing a name, the owner has 30 days to apply for a replacement title and registration, after first changing the driver license. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R97 | anchor: A08
A vehicle name change requires the title, prior registration, insurance proof, and a marriage certificate or court order. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R98 | anchor: A08
A replacement title and registration for a name change costs $35, or $55 when a lien exists. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R99 | anchor: A08
Delaware residents temporarily living more than 200 miles outside the state may renew registration by mail. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R100 | anchor: A09
The registration certificate and liability-insurance proof must travel with the vehicle whenever it is driven. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R101 | anchor: A09
The plate must be attached at the designated rear location, with the expiration-month-and-year sticker at its lower right. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R102 | anchor: A09
Registration ends at midnight on the date shown by the sticker, with no grace period. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0068]
